title: BRANEZ - Gore-Tex Freestyle
htmlContent:
BRANEZ is back with releasing his most recent single, "Gore-Tex Freestyle." BRANEZ hasn't been credited enough In the hip-hop world for all the work he's been putting in, so he genuinely gives his all and works like a master on this new song.

"Gore-Tex Freestyle" is an honest, plain, and brave approach that settles greatly for this remarkable creation. You'd never suspect he's a relative novice to the industry with merely one listen to his songs. This song stands out among the newbies.

BRANEZ "Gore-Tex Freestyle" is now available on all streaming outlets.
